'''Jacen Kodash''' was a reporter for [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] who wrote a report about the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]'s members and where they stood on the debate surrounding the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. He listed [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], [[Ronet Coorr]] of [[Iseno/Legends|Iseno]], [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]] of [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]], and [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and their stances for or against the Military Creation Act.<ref name="HNN56" />
